name: device-receipt-failed-expired
notes: Sources: docs/design/device-adapter-contract-draft.md:58-75 (§4: minimum error set unsupported, invalid_args, expired, busy, unauthorized, internal, timeout; an unknown code is treated as internal and must never be swallowed). An expired command is not executed (draft §4 rules), and a state report without an id can never complete a command (device-connector-2026-10-31.md:158-163 §4.3).
